title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（稲垣未来男研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Inagaki Mikio)
teachers:
INAGAKI Mikio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will have experience in research activities related to information technologies. This process will enhance their problem-finding, development, survey, communication, objective evaluation, and report writing abilities.
advice:
Course Overview: In this Design Project III, students will learn research and development methods in the following fields:

Systems Neuroscience: A research area focused on understanding and applying the brain's information processing as a system.
Vision Science: A research area aimed at understanding and applying the psychological characteristics of how we perceive the world through vision.

Study Advice: It is natural not to be able to conduct research activities well from the beginning. Do not hesitate to ask your instructors about anything you do not understand.
requiredKnowledge: Significant achievement comes from small and daily achievements. Students are required to conduct self-checkings every quarter.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set schedule of the project based on the goal of research topic.
Be able to set the approach or method for the project.
Be able to acquire IT knowledge and skills for proceeding the project.
Be able to deal with the problems that will occur in the process of analysis and design.
Be able to evaluate the result from subjective and objective point of view for better understanding.
